name: watch-video
description: Watch a video or a folder of clips for the edit: tags, segments, tagline, shot sheet, contact-sheet PDF, write-up. Engine byte-identical to the scan plugin's; SEE weights inside (~83 MB). 2.0.0: read-shots writes a measured ledger and a filmmaker's sentence per shot, the reader is pinned and hash-checked, and /reflect ranks a watched pool against a plain-words ask over editable templates (best = most dynamic); counts never rank.
